title: Founder, Reliance Industries
quote: Think big, think fast, think ahead. Ideas are no one's *monopoly.*
caption:
Ek chhoti si textile trading firm se India ki sabse badi company tak. Dhirubhai Ambani ne dikhaya ki bada sochne ka haq sabka hai. 🇮🇳

Real estate mein bhi yahi rule hai: bada sochiye, jaldi shuru kariye.

title: Chairman, Berkshire Hathaway
quote: Price is what you pay. *Value* is what you get.
caption: Property kharidte waqt sirf price mat dekhiye. Location, approvals, aur future growth, yahi asli value hai. 📈

title: The Big Bull of Dalal Street
quote: Respect the market. Have an open mind. Know what to stake. Know when to take a loss. *Be responsible.*
caption: India ke Big Bull ka investing mantra, jo har investor pe laagu hota hai, chahe stocks ho ya real estate. 🐂

title: Steel industrialist & philanthropist
quote: Put all your eggs in one basket, and then *watch that basket.*
caption: Carnegie ki seekh: jahan invest karo, us pe poori nazar rakho. Isliye Skai Reality mein har project ke construction updates investors ko milte hain. 🧺

title: Former Chairman, Tata Group
quote: Nothing worthwhile is ever achieved without deep thought and *hard work.*
caption: JRD Tata ne India ki pehli airline banayi aur Tata Group ko naye mukaam tak le gaye. Unki baat aaj bhi utni hi sach hai. ✈️

title: Author, Rich Dad Poor Dad
quote: The poor and the middle class work for money. The rich have *money work for them.*
caption: Rich Dad Poor Dad ki sabse badi seekh: aise assets banaiye jo aapke liye kamaayein. Real estate unmein sabse purana asset hai. 🏢

title: Chairman, Berkshire Hathaway
quote: Be fearful when others are greedy and *greedy when others are fearful.*
caption: Jab sab bech rahe hon, tab sochne ka waqt hai. Jab sab khareed rahe hon, tab sambhalne ka. Smart investor bheed ke peeche nahi chalta. 🧠
